description: This file defines the JotPadDashlet class, a custom dashboard widget for the SuiteCRM platform. It extends the Dashlet class and provides methods to display, configure, and save the contents of a simple sticky note widget within the SuiteCRM dashboard.

classes.name: JotPadDashlet
classes.description: A customizable dashlet (widget) for SuiteCRM that allows users to write and save notes directly on the dashboard. It supports configuration options such as height and title, displays saved text, and includes JavaScript for client-side interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet, loads language strings, sets default or saved configurations, and determines dashlet title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet's HTML content, including the saved note and interface elements.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Generates and returns the JavaScript needed for the dashlet's client-side functionality.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Provides the configuration form allowing users to set the dashlet's title and height.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Processes and saves user-defined configuration options such as title and height.

methods.name: saveText
methods.description: Saves the text entered into the dashlet via Ajax, decoding and cleaning the HTML content before storage.
